RULING 2 -- the standard for craft findings. The four blocking classes in config/ship_policy.v001.json stand unchanged as the only grounds for refusal. This ruling is general, not specific to this episode.

Applying both: this episode has NO finding in any of the four blocking classes. There is no held identifiable face anywhere in it -- every crowd, officer and passenger is shot from behind, checked at zoom -- and the only third-party marks are the funnel markings covered by ruling 1. The remaining findings are craft and are covered by ruling 2.
